agent_notes: All three code adaptations were generated by msAgent after loading the Skill; verification was then rerun independently with the same native entrypoints.

The first Transformers validation attempt generated an rm -rf command, triggered msAgent approval, and stopped in non-interactive mode. No source was lost; verification was rerun with fresh mktemp directories and no deletion.
The committed patch files are byte-for-byte the git diffs generated in the isolated target repositories.
The three framework runs were repeated after adapter hardening; baseline, disabled and enabled results remained exactly equal and the stricter validator passed every fresh output.
Generic-prompt forward tests used only the documented one-line request and target path; no callback, loop or step injection point was supplied in the prompt.
Raw profiler directories are intentionally not committed because they include large CANN artifacts; trace and kernel CSV sizes and SHA-256 values are recorded for integrity.
